title: The _self rules answer how a public ledger entry cites a _self doc line and how a gap step's rules miss is recorded
goal: A tested _self question (a lookup_eval.csv row of the _self root) answers how a public-root ledger entry such as a _gaps.md resolution cites a line of a _self doc, which check.py refuses as a path:line, and how a gap the gap step filed on the wrong root is recorded as a rules finding, so rag.py pack --root _self --item gives a worker the rule (seen in SP-ilqhjn3k, where ST-4czhz3ar's pack --item returned coverage none and the worker found both by reading the query-log doc and meeting the check.py error)

run: import csv,subprocess,sys;qs=('How does a _gaps.md entry in a public root cite a line of a _self doc, when check.py refuses a path:line citation of it?','How is a gap the gap step filed on the wrong root recorded as a rules finding?');rows={r['question'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv',newline='',encoding='utf-8'))};bad=[q for q in qs if q not in rows or not subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self',q],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.startswith('coverage: good')];print('no tested row or not good on _self:',bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

clauses.clause: A tested _self question (a lookup_eval.csv row of the _self root) answers how a public-root ledger entry such as a _gaps.md resolution cites a line of a _self doc, which check.py refuses as a path:line

how a gap the gap step filed on the wrong root is recorded as a rules finding, so rag.py pack --root _self --item gives a worker the rule (seen in SP-ilqhjn3k, where ST-4czhz3ar's pack --item returned coverage none and the worker found both by reading the query-log doc and meeting the check.py error)

gates.question: How does a public root's ledger entry cite a line of a _self doc, which check.py refuses as path:line: in words with the tested row's id, or with an anchor form kb/_self/<doc>.md "term"?
options: in words with the tested row's id
gates.recommendation: in words with the tested row's id
gates.answer: in words with the tested row's id

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 2 of 15, "Pack notes, router cost and query-log apply guards read what they should"): a lookup returns a wrong or missing fact until it is fixed, which the held-out answer-rate fitness test of EP-gzr4mmkm reads.
